translations.web: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
translations.bsb: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
translations.kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
